skills.name: Find Common Denominator
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting unlike fractions to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Subtract Numerators
skills.definition: Subtracting the numerators of fractions with the same denominator.

skills.name: Manage Whole Numbers
skills.definition: Separating, operating on, and recombining whole number parts in mixed numbers or whole-number operations.

skills.name: Borrowing
skills.definition: Borrowing from a whole number to resolve negative fraction differences during subtraction.

skills.name: Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing results to lowest terms, including simplifying zero fractions or converting to whole numbers.

skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting fractions with like denominators by subtracting their numerators directly.

skills.name: Common Denominator Conversion
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting unlike fractions to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Mixed Number Partitioning
skills.definition: Separating mixed numbers or whole numbers into whole-number and fraction parts to calculate independently.

skills.name: Borrowing/Regrouping
skills.definition: Borrowing one or more units from the whole-number part and converting it to the fraction part to resolve a negative fraction difference.

skills.name: Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing a fraction to its lowest terms or simplifying a mixed number with a zero fraction part to an integer.

skills.name: Find common denominator and convert
skills.definition: Find the lowest common denominator (LCD) of two unlike fractions and convert them to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Subtract numerators
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of fractions that share a common denominator.

skills.name: Extract and subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Isolate and calculate the difference between the integer parts of mixed or whole numbers.

skills.name: Regrouping and borrowing
skills.definition: Borrow one or more units from the whole number part and convert them into a fractional equivalent to resolve a negative fraction difference.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fractional part of the answer to its lowest terms.

skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the numerators of fractions that share a common denominator.

skills.name: Common Denominator Conversion
skills.definition: Finding a common denominator and converting fractions with unlike denominators into equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Whole Number Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the integer or whole-number components in problems involving mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Fraction Borrowing
skills.definition: Borrowing from the whole-number part to add to the fraction part when the fraction subtraction results in a negative value.

skills.name: Fraction Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing a fraction or the fractional part of a mixed number to its lowest terms.

skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the numerators of fractions with identical denominators.

skills.name: Finding Common Denominator
skills.definition: Finding the least common multiple of unlike denominators and converting fractions to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Whole Number Operations
skills.definition: Separating and subtracting the whole number components of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Regrouping / Borrowing
skills.definition: Borrowing one or more units from the whole number part and converting it to a fraction to resolve a negative fraction difference.
